routines.name: crc16
routines.scope: CRC-16 return and read-only memory comparison for signed lengths -3..65, 127 and 255 with deterministic input data and both cached/uncached RAM aliases.

routines.name: packet_validator
routines.scope: Return and full 64-byte memory comparison for checksum success/failure, every padding-byte early exit, ignored header bytes, mixed packets, and both RAM aliases.

routines.name: packet_buffer_check
routines.scope: Return and full context-memory comparison for nonzero state, sentinel bypass, matching CRC and mismatched CRC after payload copy, under both RAM aliases.

limitations: Unmapped pointers, SH-4 exception/cache effects, and the CRC INT_MIN post-decrement case that would execute over two billion iterations are outside this test.
